attchmntText: Pursuant to the relevant provisions of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 as amended, please find enclosed a press release dated 12th November 2026, regarding the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.
voiceSummary: Amber Enterprises India Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2FY27 was Rs. 2,627 Cr, showing 60% growth year-on-year. Operating EBITDA for the quarter was Rs. 127 Cr, up 30%. Adjusted loss after tax was Rs. 57 Cr. For H1FY27, revenue from operations was Rs. 6,515 Cr, with 28% growth. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 464 Cr, up 29%. Adjusted profit after tax was Rs. 69 Cr. The Consumer Durables division saw 41% revenue growth. The Electronics division reported 94% growth. The Railway Sub-systems and Defence division recorded 15% growth. The press release was issued on 12th November 2026.

attchmntText: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Amber Enterprises India Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for H1FY27 reached 6,515 Crore, a 28% increase from H1FY26. Operating EBITDA stood at 464 Crore, up 29%. Reported PAT for H1FY27 was a loss of 63 Crore, while adjusted PAT was 74 Crore. The company incorporated Amber Digital Technologies Pvt Ltd for mobile phone manufacturing operations for Oppo. IL JIN acquired remaining stakes in Power-One and Ascent Circuits, making them wholly owned subsidiaries. The Consumer Durables Division reported revenue of 3,985 Crore. The Electronics Division revenue grew to 2,233 Crore. The Railways Sub-systems and Mobility Division revenue was 297 Crore.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations and further to our intimation dated 7th November 2026, we wish to inform the stock exchanges that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on Thursday, 12th November 2026, has, inter alia, considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Amber Enterprises India Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 12th November 2026. The company submitted standalone and consolidated results along with a limited review report from statutory auditor M/s S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP. The auditor reported no material misstatements in the financial statements prepared under Indian Accounting Standard 34. Standalone total assets stood at 7,81,994.41 thousand rupees as of 30th September 2026 compared to 8,31,685.96 thousand rupees on 31st March 2026. Standalone total equity was 3,06,932.39 thousand rupees. Cash and cash equivalents decreased to 58,908.9 thousand rupees from 7,663.27 thousand rupees at the start of the period. The results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has scheduled an earnings call for Friday, 13th November 2026, at 5:30 P.M. IST to discuss the unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The call will feature Executive Chairman and CEO Jasbir Singh, Managing Director Daljit Singh, Chief Financial Officer Sudhir Goyal, and Head of Investor Relations Ravi Kharbanda. Participants can register via the company website or use the provided local and international toll-free access numbers. The information is also available on the company's investor relations page.

attchmntText: In furtherance to our earlier intimation dated 11th July 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited (formerly known as IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited), a material subsidiary of the Company, has filed the Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated 6th November 2026, on 7th November 2026 with the SEBI, BSE and NSE in connection with its proposed Initial Public Offer.
voiceSummary: Amber Enterprises India Limited intimates that its material subsidiary, IL JIN Electronics India Limited, filed the Draft Red Herring Prospectus on 7th November 2026 with the Securities and Exchange Board of India, BSE Limited, and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. This filing relates to the proposed Initial Public Offer of IL JIN Electronics India Limited. The IPO is subject to receipt of required regulatory approvals. The intimation was made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI LODR Regulations. The information is available on the company website at www.ambergroupindia.com.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company ("IL JIN") has completed the acquisition of the balance 40% equity stake of Power-One Micro Systems Private Limited ("Power-One") from Mr. Ramanna Rajesh Mayasandra, Mr. Harsha Venkatesh, Dwaith Advisory Private Limited and Mrs. Doddabidere Honappa Venna, shareholders of Power-One, pursuant to Share Swap agreement executed on 18th October 2026, thereby making Power-One a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of IL JIN and Wholly-Owned step down subsidiary of the Company. Further, 1,76,000 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares A3 have been allotted by IL JIN to Mr. Ramanna Rajesh Mayasandra, Mr. Harsha Venkatesh, Dwaith Advisory Private Limited and Mrs. Doddabidere Honappa Veena, as a non -cash consideration, for the aforesaid, in terms of the said Share Swap Agreement.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company ("IL JIN") has completed acquisition of the balance 1.50% equity stake of Ascent Circuits Private Limited ("Ascent Circuits"), from Ms. Manju Thomas, shareholder of Ascent Circuits, pursuant to Share Swap Agreement executed on 18th October 2026, thereby making Ascent Circuits Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of IL JIN and Wholly-Owned step down subsidiary of the Company. Further, 13,120 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares A2 have been allotted by IL JIN to Ms. Manju Thomas, as non-cash consideration, for the aforesaid acquisition, in terms of the said Share Swap Agreement.
